core_style.default_register: casual - often uses slang and informal language
core_style.sentence_shape: clipped fragments - frequently uses short, punchy statements
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative - quick transitions between thoughts and ideas
core_style.two_registers: rarely shifts to a more serious tone when discussing family or authority, but defaults to casual humor

humor.style: absurdist - often makes nonsensical or exaggerated statements
humor.frequency: constant - humor is a regular part of interactions
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert - often sets up a situation only to twist it unexpectedly

structural_patterns: uses rhetorical questions to assert dominance
speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames situations or people humorously, revealing a playful relationship with authority
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes more direct and less playful, often shorter and more serious

vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of ellipses and interruptions

worldview.authority is often incompetent: Bart frequently mocks authority figures, showing a lack of respect for their decisions
worldview.family is a source of support: Bart expresses appreciation for his parents, indicating he values their presence despite his mischief

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: I’m a troublemaker who enjoys pushing boundaries
self_image_vs_reality.reality: Bart often finds himself in trouble but relies on his family for support
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: when confronted, he often deflects with humor or sarcasm

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses humor to deflect serious questions, maintaining a casual tone
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes faster and more fragmented, showing signs of panic
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, blunt statements, lacking his usual humor
emotional_tells.when_in_control: displays confidence through assertive statements and playful banter

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially tries to stall or joke, but may resort to fleeing if that fails
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with sarcasm and humor, often undermining their authority
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes more serious and assertive, showing a protective instinct
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: often redirects the conversation or makes a joke to deflect the embarrassment

escalation_pattern: starts with humor, escalates to sarcasm, and may end in defiance or retreat if challenged
conversation_goals: gain approval or attention from peers

relationship_matrix.MILHOUSE: Bart sees Milhouse as a close friend and often involves him in his schemes
relationship_matrix.HOMER: Bart has a playful yet rebellious relationship with Homer, often testing boundaries

surface: school subjects like geography, but lacks depth
